title: Provisions Configuration
description: Schema for the merged provisions document (default + user override). Provisions are optional, non-persona capabilities installed alongside roles. Tool names in 'targets' are validated by pattern, not an enumerated list, so support for new tools is a data change.

version.description: Schema version of this provisions document.

provisions.description: Map of provision name to definition.

bundles.description: Map of bundle name to definition.

toolName.description: An output format / tool identifier (e.g. claude, cursor).

kind.description: Dispatch key selecting the strategy that applies this provision.

enabled.description: Whether this provision is applied by 'provision apply' / install-all.

targets.description: Tools this provision targets. Unsupported tools report 'unsupported'.

settings.description: tool-setting: object deep-merged into the tool's settings file.

install.description: plugin: marketplace/plugin/interactive details for the install driver.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the bundle installs together.

members.description: Provision names that make up the bundle.

install_order.description: Explicit ordering (critical when members install competing hooks).

overrides.description: Bundle-scoped config that wins over each member's own defaults.

enabled.description: Installing a bundle enables its members as a unit.
